anchor_definition: The anchor is the first target-specific value-construction function on the dynamic behavior chain: the earliest function, after routing and input preparation, whose own body constructs the target observable value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, packaging the result, or emitting it to the sink or localStorage call.

primary_anchor.source_export: private helper reached through exported u(config)
primary_anchor.answer_basis: Agent-visible corpus only: the canonical anchor answer is captured_span plus answer_function as declared in the captured bundle slice. source_function is a private maintainer mapping into src/.
primary_anchor.why: Constructs the target assignment_code by folding the assignment envelope cells (flag, variant reference, version, rollout scope, session key, persist flag) through the runtime-selected reducer variant and combining the fold result with the assignment state frame into the 12-char base36 persistence code that is placed into the flag.persist console object and the ff_state localStorage record.

acceptable_hit_conditions: Canonical match is primary_anchor.captured_span in the captured bundle (hash/offset/complete function body). Agents only see captures, so the standard answer identifier is primary_anchor.answer_function, not source_function.

A returned function name is scored against answer_function in the captured corpus. source_function is a private maintainer label and is not something an agent can know unless the bundle still exposes that exact identifier.
Agent explanation distinguishes the anchor from routing, input preparation, wrapper, sink, storage write, core utility and off-chain decoy functions.
A snippet answer is accepted only when it maps uniquely to one complete enclosing function in the captured corpus.

Formats the folded result and frame into the final 12-char base36 code shape directly below the anchor.
Builds the route, scope and envelope-derived frame mixed with the fold result by the anchor.
Executes the selected reducer variant folding the normalized assignment envelope cells.
Assembles the assignment envelope cells (flag, variant reference, version, scope, session, persist flag) that the anchor folds into the persistence code.
Context-frame encoder reused by the shadow_assignment debug emitter; target-adjacent material on the same module but not on the target assignment_code path.
Generic base36 folding utility reused by the preferences-store cell tag and the shadow decoy emitters.
Generic cell-shape formatter used by the envelope joiner.
Generic ordered cell joiner over cell shapes.
Generic row filler used by the cell joiner.

scoring_policy.source_level_answer: not_applicable_for_default_agent_corpus; grade by captured_span and answer_function only
scoring_policy.span_overlap_policy: score by the unique role_oracle row whose captured_span fully contains the submitted span, or whose captured_span is fully contained by a uniquely submitted enclosing function span

do_not_promote: The final console sink and localStorage write site emit an already constructed assignment_code value.
The exported factory only wraps the private assignment-envelope anchor and should not outrank the anchor itself.
Session/scope collection, version reading and tuple building are generic preparation, not the target value constructor.
The scopeCellMark/storeAuditCandidate chain is an inactive decoy and is not called by the assignment_code encode path.
The shadow_assignment debug emitter writes a ctx-styled fake frame and is off the target chain.
Non-target flag-style console objects can carry assignment_code-like values but are not the requested observable action.
debug_hints_private: Canonical anchor answer id: primary_anchor.answer_function at primary_anchor.captured_span in the captured bundle.
primary_anchor.source_function is only for maintainer mapping back to src/ and may differ after obfuscation.
The target field name (assignment_code) and the ff_state storage key are assembled at the sink from character-code arrays.
The delegated click action key is 5:64:1 (lane 5, kind 1, weight 64); the async queue fires in order mutation -> frame -> then -> micro -> timer; the local event plane channel is z0:store-plane.
Source paths are private evaluator mapping aids, not the default answer space.
captured_span coordinates are regenerated by scripts/gen_oracle_spans.mjs after npm run build.

scoring_examples.matched_reason: Returned span maps uniquely to primary_anchor.captured_span; answer_function matches the encodeAssignmentEnvelope declaration in that captured bundle slice.
Returned span maps to a target-specific helper below the anchor, such as encodeAssignmentCode, assignmentStateFrame, buildEnvelopeCells or runFold.
Returned span maps to a generic utility directly used by the code construction path, or the base36 folder and envelope serializer reused by non-target emitters.
Returned span maps to a path-critical routing/materialization/wrapper function or the final output wrapper.
Returned span maps to a generic DOM, tuple, namespace, version or field-name helper used in upstream preparation.
Returned span maps to an off-chain decoy or cannot be uniquely mapped to a captured function.
